Private enterprise development

Private firms can contribute to development through employment, investment, innovation, and the production of goods and services. Small firms in low income settings often face constraints involving finance, technology, management, and market access.

Research in this area studies which constraints matter most and whether interventions can improve firm performance. Understanding firm behaviour is important for designing policies aimed at productivity and employment.
